name: K-Means Clustering Assignment and Centroid Update in Pure SQL
description: Unsupervised customer segmentation can be run directly inside DuckDB by assigning customer vectors to the nearest centroid and recomputing cluster means in a single query.
prompt:
Unsupervised customer segmentation can be run directly inside DuckDB by assigning customer vectors to the nearest centroid and recomputing cluster means in a single query.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: point_id, assigned_cluster, distance_to_center.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Step 1: Assign each point to the closest cluster centroid via array_distance
            WITH point_distances AS (
                SELECT 
                    p.point_id,
                    p.coord,
                    c.cluster_id,
                    array_distance(p.coord, c.center) AS dist,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.point_id ORDER BY array_distance(p.coord, c.center) ASC) AS rank_closest
                FROM data_points p
                CROSS JOIN cluster_centroids c
            )
            SELECT 
                point_id,
                cluster_id AS assigned_cluster,
                ROUND(dist, 4) AS distance_to_center
            FROM point_distances
            WHERE rank_closest = 1
            ORDER BY point_id;
why_it_fails: Running ML clustering outside the warehouse requires exporting millions of vectors over the network.
